behavior: AC1: no MinIO workload/Service/IngressRoute/PVC/CronJob in staging or prod
verification: for e in staging prod; do ! kubectl --kubeconfig ~/.kube/kubelab-$e-config -n kubelab get deploy,svc,pvc,cronjob,ingressroute -o name | grep -i -E 'minio|pvc-backup'; done

behavior: AC2: no MinIO container or data dir on the Beelink; re-provision changed=0
verification: ssh bee '! docker ps -a --format {{.Names}} | grep -qx minio && test ! -e /opt/minio'

verification: for h in auth.staging.kubelab.live auth.kubelab.live; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}' "https://$h/api/oidc/authorization?client_id=minio&response_type=code&scope=openid&state=probe12345678&redirect_uri=https://x/cb" | grep -q invalid_client || exit 1; done
